messages:
alisa: Quick heads-up — kernel ABI bump + quant-build-v2 going to canary in tonight's midnight change window. Need a short pre-bake sweep (smoke + warmups), ops handover, and pin/rollback instructions ready. Target window: 00:30–02:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for 00:30 UTC. Canary plan: 1% traffic start, hold for prebake + gate checks, then step to 5% if all green. Canary ID: cb-20260320-01.

ci-bot: build uploaded: quant-v2-2026-03-20 (sha: a1b2c3d4). Artifacts: s3://redwood-builds/quant-v2/quant-v2-2026-03-20.tar.gz. Prebake image: prebake-quantv2:2026-03-20.

kenji: What exactly do you want in the prebake sweep? Quick perf (p50/p95), mem, and smoke prompts?

alisa: Yes. Run smoke_prompts + 10k tokens of synthetic load on matmul-v2 and matmul-v1 fallback. Look for p95 latency regression > 3% vs baseline, error rate > 1.5% absolute, or any correctness regression flagged by the eval set (>2% fail on smoke_prompts).

irene: Telemetry gates:
- p95 latency increase > 3% -> fail
- error rate increase > 0.5pp (absolute) -> fail
- eval/regression on smoke_prompts: > 2% -> fail
- token throughput drop > 5% -> warn
Provide metric links in thread.

sunya: Prebake commands:
```
# run prebake sweep locally (CI runner)
./tools/prebake.sh --build quant-v2-2026-03-20 \\n  --kernels matmul_v2,matmul_fallback \\n  --dataset smoke_prompts.json \\n  --tokens 10000 \
  --out results/prebake-quantv2.json
```
Also run the warmup script to populate KV cache: `./tools/warmup_cache.sh --model matmul_v2 --count 500`.

mike: I'll own the prebake runs from 23:45 UTC and post results. If prebake passes, i'll trigger deploy-bot to start canary.

ops-oncall: Handover checklist:
- Pager channel ready (#incidents)
- Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/runbooks/kernel-rollout
- Log tailing: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -c inference --since=10m`
- Alerts to watch: runtime_errors_5m, p95_latency_5m, quant_fallback_rate
- Escalation: call +1-555-0100 if >2% fail for 10m

alisa: Rollback criteria (explicit):
- Any gate marked "fail" in prebake -> do NOT advance.
- During canary: if p95 > 5% increase OR error rate > 1.5% absolute OR eval regression >3% -> immediate rollback to matmul-v1 and pin current build.
Rollback command (deploy-bot): `deploy-bot pin runtime matmul-v1 --reason "rollback-quantv2"`

ci-bot: Post-prebake artifacts: prebake report at https://ci.redwood/prebake/cb-20260320-01/result.json (contains traces, diffs, and sample failures).

kenji: I'll prepare a short release note and the pin script snippet. For emergency rollback we should also have the CLI quick command ready: `rctl rollout rollback cb-20260320-01 --force`

deploy-bot: canary started at 00:30 UTC. Canary targets: routes/runtime:matmul -> variant=quant-v2 (1% traffic). Metrics: https://dash.redwood/canaries/cb-20260320-01

mike: Prebake run complete — no gate failures. p95 +1.1%, errors flat, eval regression 0.6%. Uploading prebake report now.

irene: Reviewing prebake report — looks good. I'll keep a 30m watch on eval drift and p95 during the 1% window.

alisa: Thanks — once we hit 5% and hold for 20m with all gates green, proceed with gradual rollout per standard cadence. Ops: you have the channel. I'll be on standby for rollback.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Monitoring dashboards and alerting are configured. Will ping here on anomalies.

mike: Canary progressed to 5% at 01:10 UTC with no alerts so far.

alisa: Great — keeping this thread for post-deploy notes/any anomalies. If anybody sees anything odd ping @ops-oncall and call the rollback command.
